$comment: Tracked mod manifest. Sourced from CurseForge. Jars are NOT committed; install via npm run start or your CurseForge launcher.

added_for_ftb_quests_migration.purpose: Tree-based quest book UI replacing the legacy Checklist book.
Required dependency of FTB Quests and FTB Teams.
Team / single-player mode backing for FTB Quests. Configured to 'single' so quests are per-player.

notes: Drop the three jars into ./minecraft/mods/ before running 'npm run start'.
The Checklist mod is intentionally kept installed in parallel — both quest systems coexist.
CurseForge project IDs are stable; recommended file versions update as the modpack moves forward — re-pin per release.
